segments.narration: Thirty thousand died in minutes; a prisoner walked out. Mount Pelee erupted over Saint-Pierre, Martinique at 7:52 that May morning in 1902.
Ludger Sylbaris had been arrested days earlier for assault. The night before the eruption, he was thrown into solitary for trying to escape.
So why did the punishment cell beat the whole city? Everything above ground burned. Rescuers heard him shouting three days later.
The cell was a bomb-proof magazine, stone, partly underground, windowless. Its only vent was a slit in the door facing away from the mountain.
Hot ash still burned his arms and back, but his clothes never caught. He was pardoned, then toured with Barnum and Bailey.
